items.t: Engine oil sludge (oil gel) on the ES300
items.job: Remove valve covers and oil pan to clean out sludge
items.note: If sludge has already damaged the bearings, an engine replacement costs much more.

items.t: Driver airbag cover may tear (campaign 1LG)
items.note: Free under a Lexus campaign. Check your VIN or ask a Lexus dealer.

items.t: Hesitation, surging or harsh shifts in the automatic
items.job: Update transmission software and change the fluid
items.note: If the transmission is worn, a rebuild or replacement costs much more.

items.t: Front brake vibration when stopping
items.job: Replace front brake rotors and pads
items.note: Resurfacing the rotors costs less if they are thick enough.

items.t: Front power window regulator can bend
items.note: Price is per door. If the motor must also be replaced, it costs more.

items.t: Throttle body may set the check engine light (campaign 3LF)
items.note: Covered by a Lexus campaign for affected cars. Check your VIN or ask a Lexus dealer.

items.t: VVT-i oil hose can burst
items.job: Replace rubber VVT-i oil hose with metal line
items.note: Free under a Lexus campaign. Check your VIN. Cost rises a lot if the engine ran low on oil.

items.t: Oil leak from the timing chain cover
items.job: Remove and reseal timing chain cover
items.note: Big labor job. Many owners replace the water pump and drive belt at the same time.

items.t: Ticking or rattle with cam timing codes
items.note: Some cases only need one gear or an oil control valve, which costs less.

items.t: Torque converter shudder
items.job: Replace torque converter and update transmission software
items.note: Some cars improve with a fluid change and software update alone. A full transmission costs much more.

items.t: Clunk or knock from the steering shaft
Floor mat can trap the gas pedal (recall 09V-388)
items.job: Recall repair: reshape gas pedal and replace floor mats
items.note: Free under recall. Check your VIN or ask a Lexus dealer.

items.t: Dashboard turns sticky, shiny or cracked
items.note: Lexus had a warranty extension for this. Ask a dealer if it still applies. A dash cover costs far less.

items.t: Water pump leaks coolant
items.note: Often done with the drive belt. Overheating damage costs much more.

items.t: Pre-collision system can brake on its own (recall 15V-728)
items.note: Free under recall. Check your VIN or ask a Lexus dealer.

items.t: ES 300h check engine light for hybrid inverter code
items.job: Diagnose hybrid code and replace inverter coolant pump
items.note: Some cars only need a software update. A full inverter costs much more. Ask about hybrid warranty coverage.

items.t: Fuel pump may fail and stall the engine (recall 20V-682)
items.note: Free under recall. Check your VIN or ask a Lexus dealer.

items.t: ES 300h brake booster pump may fail (recall 19V-544)
items.note: Free under recall. Check your VIN or ask a Lexus dealer.

items.t: ES 300h engine casting may crack and leak coolant (recall 20V-064)
items.note: Free under recall. Check your VIN or ask a Lexus dealer.

items.t: Passenger airbag may not deploy (recall 23V-865)
items.note: Free under recall. Check your VIN or ask a Lexus dealer.

items.t: ES 300h backup camera image may be delayed (recall 24V-124)
items.note: Free under recall. Check your VIN or ask a Lexus dealer.

items.t: Steering tie rod lock nut may loosen (recall 17V-415)
items.job: Inspect tie rod lock nut, replace steering gear and tie rod if loose
items.note: Free under recall 17V-415. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Brake actuator seal may be damaged (recall 16V-198)
items.job: Inspect ABS brake actuator and replace if needed
items.note: Free under recall 16V-198. Check the VIN first.

items.t: ES 300 automatic can slip, flare or quit
items.job: Rebuild or replace the automatic transmission

items.t: Oil seeps from the valve covers, oil pan and rear main seal
items.job: Reseal valve covers, oil pan and rear main seal
